title: Associate Optical Engineer (Level 2)
roleOverview: Elevate your vision for the future! Clarity, a world-renowned manufacturer of innovative eyewear, seeks a passionate Associate Optical Engineer (Level 2) to join our growing team. In this progressive role, you'll leverage your developing expertise to contribute significantly to the design, analysis, and optimization of advanced optical components for our next-generation eyewear solutions. You'll collaborate with industry experts, tackle challenging projects, and gain valuable experience that will propel your career forward.
keyResponsibilities:
• Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and analysis of optical components and systems using industry-standard software (e.g., Zemax, Code V).
  • Independently conduct optical simulations and analyses to evaluate performance metrics (e.g., image quality, light transmission, field of view).
  • Lead problem-solving efforts for assigned optical design challenges, proposing innovative solutions and collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., manufacturing, research) to achieve optimal results.
  • Actively participate in the development and testing of optical prototypes, ensuring functionality, manufacturability, and adherence to design specifications.
  • Create and maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation for assigned projects, including optical designs, test procedures, and results.
  • Stay abreast of advancements in optical technology and materials, actively seeking opportunities to integrate new knowledge into ongoing projects.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of optical design processes and methodologies.
qualificationsAndSkills:
• Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field (required).
  • 2-4 years of experience in applied optics or a related field, with demonstrable experience using optical design software (e.g., Zemax, Code V).
  • Strong understanding of optical design principles and theories (e.g., geometrical optics, physical optics) and their application to real-world problems.
  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and present technical information clearly.
  • A meticulous eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • A passion for learning and a desire to continuously develop your skills within the field of optical engineering.

title: Associate Web Developer
roleOverview: See the world of web development in focus! Clarity, a leading global manufacturer of innovative eyewear, seeks a talented Associate Web Developer to join our growing team. In this exciting role, you'll gain valuable experience working alongside industry professionals, contributing to the development and maintenance of our web properties. You'll help us craft user-friendly and visually appealing web experiences that showcase our brand and connect with our customers.
keyResponsibilities:
• Collaborate with designers and web developers to translate design concepts into functional and visually appealing web pages.
  • Develop and implement well-structured, maintainable, and efficient code using front-end web development technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable UI components for a consistent brand identity across our web platforms.
  • Assist with website optimization for speed and responsiveness across various devices (desktop, mobile, tablet).
  • Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure website functionality and identify and resolve basic technical issues.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest web development trends and technologies, actively seeking opportunities to learn and grow your skillset.
  • Maintain clear and concise code documentation to ensure smooth collaboration and future updates.
  • Assist with content management tasks to keep website content fresh and engaging.
qualificationsAndSkills:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred).
  • 1-2 years of experience in web development or a strong portfolio showcasing your skills.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript concepts.
  • Experience with a front-end web development framework (e.g., React, Angular) (a plus).
  • A strong eye for design and a keen understanding of user experience (UX) principles.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to learn from experienced developers.
  • A problem-solving mindset and a willingness to tackle new challenges.
  • A passion for learning and a desire to grow your web development skills.

title: Associate of Product Quality
roleOverview: See quality through every lens! Clarity, a leading global manufacturer of innovative eyewear, seeks a detail-oriented Associate of Product Quality to join our growing team. In this vital role, you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality and consistency of our eyewear products, from raw materials to finished goods. You'll conduct inspections, analyze data, and collaborate with colleagues to maintain Clarity's reputation for exceptional craftsmanship.
keyResponsibilities:
• Conduct visual inspections of eyewear components and finished products according to established quality control standards.
  • Utilize measuring tools and gauges to verify product dimensions and specifications.
  • Perform basic quality control tests to identify and document any defects or inconsistencies.
  • Analyze inspection data and identify trends to pinpoint potential quality issues.
  • Participate in root cause analysis to determine the source of quality problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist with maintaining and calibrating quality control equipment.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date quality control documentation.
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure adherence to quality standards and implement corrective actions.
  • Stay up-to-date on quality control procedures and industry best practices.
qualificationsAndSkills:
• High school diploma or equivalent (preferred).
  • A strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance.
  • Basic understanding of quality control principles and methodologies (a plus).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team to achieve quality goals.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively document findings and collaborate with colleagues.
  • Proficient in basic math and data analysis.
  • Ability to follow instructions and adhere to established quality control procedures.
  • A strong work ethic and a commitment to continuous improvement.

title: Warehouse Associate
roleOverview: See your contribution in every shipment! Clarity, a leading global manufacturer of innovative eyewear, seeks a passionate Warehouse Associate to join our dynamic team. In this fast-paced role, you'll play a vital role in keeping our warehouse running smoothly, ensuring timely order fulfillment, accurate inventory control, and efficient product distribution. You'll be responsible for various tasks that contribute to Clarity's success in delivering exceptional vision solutions to our customers worldwide.
keyResponsibilities:
• Receive, unload, and inspect incoming shipments of eyewear products, verifying accuracy and completeness.
  • Organize, store, and maintain inventory according to designated locations and established protocols.
  • Carefully pick, pack, and ship orders according to customer specifications, ensuring accuracy and timely dispatch.
  • Conduct cycle counts and assist with regular inventory audits to maintain data integrity.
  • Operate warehouse equipment safely and efficiently (e.g., pallet jacks, forklifts if qualified).
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment, adhering to all safety policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate effectively with other warehouse associates and support staff.
qualificationsAndSkills:
• High school diploma or equivalent (preferred).
  • A strong work ethic, with a commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and safety.
  • Ability to lift and maneuver moderate weights (up to 50 lbs).
  • Excellent organizational skills and a keen eye for detail.
  • Basic computer literacy and the ability to learn new warehouse management systems (WMS) quickly.
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • A positive attitude and a willingness to learn and grow.
